# Hi there <img src="https://github.com/TheDudeThatCode/TheDudeThatCode/blob/master/Assets/Hi.gif" width="30px"> I'm Ahmad 🧑🏻

I research how **AI and learning analytics can make feedback better for students**, at scale and in ways teachers trust.

PhD candidate at the [Centre for Learning Analytics](https://www.monash.edu/colam), **Monash University** (thesis submission December 2026) · Lecturer at **Universitas Teknokrat Indonesia**

> 🔎 **Open to postdoctoral positions from 2027** in AI in education, learning analytics, and educational NLP.

## 🧭 Research Focus

- **Feedback analytics at scale:** ML and NLP models that characterise the quality of written feedback.
- **LLMs for feedback:** how well large language models generate and analyse feedback, across prompting strategies.
- **Human-centred AI with teachers:** how educators use, trust, and adapt AI-supported feedback tools.

## ✨ Highlights

- 📄 First-author articles in *Computers & Education*, *Computers and Education: AI*, and *Assessment & Evaluation in Higher Education*
- 🧪 Built the feedback classification model inside [PolyFeed](https://www.polyfeed.com.au/), an AI-supported feedback analytics system
- 🎓 Teaching data science at Monash University and Universitas Teknokrat Indonesia

Publications, doctoral research, and CV on my **[website](https://ahmadarialdino.github.io/)**.
